findings.claim: 候选仅在原lifecycle版本允许集合追加已有v6累计版本，解决原有效生命周期在v6下被误拒，未改变字段/数据/签名/执行或发布授权。
findings.evidence: 材料 `.evidence/qyh-media-cumulative-lifecycle-contract-20261013/review-diff.txt` 中仅对 `services/aos-api/aos_api/ecommerce_workshop_media_studio_contracts.py` 的 `WorkshopMediaStudioViewEnvelope._canonical_shape` 一处三行变更：将 `if self.schema_version != MEDIA_STUDIO_PUBLISH_SCHEMA_VERSION:` 替换为包含 `MEDIA_STUDIO_CUMULATIVE_SCHEMA_VERSION` 的集合判断。材料 `.evidence/qyh-media-cumulative-lifecycle-contract-20261013/review-contract.txt` 显示 `MEDIA_STUDIO_CUMULATIVE_SCHEMA_VERSION = "aos.ecommerce-workshop.media-studio-view/v6"` 为新增/现有常量，`external_effects_allowed`、`release_allowed`、lifecycle/publish/contributions 字段与 `Literal` / validator 均未变动。

findings.claim: 服务层专项覆盖有生命周期的v6正向、v2/v3拒绝、v4/v5兼容及blocked生命周期与产物冲突拒绝，原external_effects_allowed和release_allowed门保留；fixture不冒充当前原生或经营验收。
findings.evidence: 材料 `.evidence/qyh-media-cumulative-lifecycle-contract-20261013/review-tests.txt` 中 `test_v6_keeps_existing_lifecycle_and_external_gates` 验证 v6 schema 下 `lifecycle_status == 'ready'`、`external_effects_allowed is False`、`release_allowed is False`；`test_legacy_v2_v3_still_reject_lifecycle` 验证 v2/v3 抛 `legacy media view cannot carry v4 lifecycle`；`test_original_v4_v5_lifecycle_remains_valid` 验证 v4/v5 保留有效生命周期；`test_v6_blocked_lifecycle_cannot_carry_contribution` 验证 blocked lifecycle 与 contribution 冲突拒绝。测试使用 `composer` 构造的固定 `CUTOFF` 与本地 `EcommerceWorkshopMediaCumulative().read(cutoff=CUTOFF)` 作为 fixture，未调用原生/经营真实数据源。
